ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited has announced the positive closure of its USFDA inspection at the Vadodara Bioequivalence Facility, conducted in March 2025, with the issuance of an Establishment Inspection Report (EIR). This outcome confirms the facility meets regulatory standards, thereby removing significant operational and financial uncertainty related to its U.S. market access. The report presents no red flags, indicating a favorable regulatory standing for the company.
